text_block_list.text:
I'm designing Марузенски's new training
plan for
the new year, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Happy New Year! ☆
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Happy New Year! ☆
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I thought there was a chance you might
be here,
and lo and behold, here you
are!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You're certainly getting work started
early this
year.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list:
It's because I want you to have as much fun
running as possible!

text_block_list.text: "Have fun," huh...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're going all out for me, then
I'll have
to work just as hard!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
So? What do you have on the docket for
me?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: I want to boost that lightning speed of yours!
I want to focus on physical conditioning!

I want to help you get better at other running
styles!

text_block_list.text:
So? What do you have on the docket for
me?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: I want to boost that lightning speed of yours!
I want to focus on physical conditioning!

I want to help you get better at other running
styles!

text_block_list.text:
You want to see more of that
high-octane running
of mine, huh?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I bet running even faster than I do now
would feel
amazing!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh? I thought you were going to make
me do
some super hardcore training or
something...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But I guess you can't train if you aren't
healthy.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm so impressed that you have your
eye on
something other than speed!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's totally important to broaden your
skill set if
you're thinking about running
in a variety of
races.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's a deal, cockatiel! I'll focus on that
during my
training!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll try to be aware of that! Maybe
I should
work on drifting...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll work on taking care of my
health. I'll
have to make sure I don't
overeat during New
Year's!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the new year just began, but
you're
already working so hard for my
sake...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the new year just began, but
you're
already working so hard for my
sake...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I've been working hard since New Year's
too... for
the sake of all the adorable
younger students!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Heehee! Just watch, and you'll see!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски lays out a tablecloth on the
desk and
begins placing cups on top of
it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Here I go... Watch this!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Swoosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ta-da! A tablecloth pull! The younger students are going to love this for sure!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be New Year's without the
parlor
tricks, right?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list:
Parlor tricks, huh? I remember when they used
to show those on TV! That sure brings back
memories...

text_block_list.text: Huh? It does?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! You mean they don't do
parlor tricks
on TV anymore? Even on
New Year's?!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Err... Well, I guess it doesn't matter if it's
out of
date or not, as long as people
enjoy it, right?
Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Thus begins a new year with
Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
